(1275449912004) in full (WebSearch restricted to etsy.com; www.etsy.com answers 403 to the relay), decide whether the workbook's README sheet counts as 'information buyers rely on to … use your item' that 'must be your own work', and either record in LISTING.md that a disclosed spreadsheet tool is a 'designed by a seller' item with no change, or draft a ≤ 15-minute owner note replacing the README sheet's text with the owner's own words (an `owner:` ALERTS line and action file); update LISTING.md §Status and RESEARCH §9 either way
items.why: Found by the 2026-11-02 new-ventures spike etsy-claude-code-kit-listing: help.etsy.com now lists 'AI-generated functional instructions' and 'bot-generated content' among the content not allowed, and the handbook says listings that fail may be removed with the shop. The workbook is a tool, disclosed 'made by me with the help of AI tools', which the help centre allows under 'designed by a seller'; its README sheet is the one part that reads as instructions. A shop removal would end the line's only live shelf, so a 0.1-day read before the 12-28 day-60 reading is cheap insurance. Evidence 3 × reach 1 ÷ (0.1 + ≤ 15 owner min) ≈ 3. — Done 2026-11-02 (burn-down): the listing stays. The rule targets functional guides (patterns, recipes, instructions, manuals, instructional e-books) and asks them to show an actual result; the workbook is a disclosed spreadsheet tool with real preview screenshots and a hand-checked Example tab, typed into Etsy by the owner. The README tab is the one part a strict reading could call instructions: no owner time now; if Etsy flags the listing, its text is replaced with the owner's own words (~10 min, rebuild, re-upload). LISTING.md §Status row dated 2026-11-02.

items.why: Distribution before features (STRATEGY §6): three shelves and the own page have been live 1–5 days with 0 sales, and the only reach we control is the product page. A Google search for 'sole trader tax calculator 2026/27 UK free' (WebSearch 2026-11-03) returns three Payhip product pages and an Etsy listing among the free calculators, so product pages do rank for the buyer's query; ours has no structured data, no FAQ and no question-shaped headings (checked 2026-11-03: 0 ld+json blocks, h2s 'Where to buy', 'What you get', 'At a glance', 'Please read before buying', 'Refunds'). Product/Offer markup is what Google's free product listings and rich results read; FAQPage markup is still read for rich results on government and health sites only, but the FAQ text itself targets the long-tail queries. Zero owner minutes, zero spend, one deploy (the landing CI). Built 2026-11-03: Product with three Offers (own checkout, Etsy, Payhip; priceValidUntil 2026-11-30, the launch price's end) and FAQPage mirroring five visible questions; the hero listing image served as tax-workbook-hero.png; thanks page was already noindex; the reseller page does not exist yet (its listing is Etsy-only). The guide (£4.99) and the workbook (£6.99) sell to the same person for the same tax year; a back-matter page is the standard Kindle cross-sell and KDP's guidelines allow links to the author's own site. Cost: 0.1 day, zero owner minutes now — the own-checkout file updates on deploy, the Kindle and Etsy copies when they are next re-uploaded anyway. Worth doing before the first re-upload so the April refresh carries it. — Built 2026-11-05 (build): src/kindle/content.ts gains the back-matter page 'Also from Foundry Tax Guides' (the workbook named once, moved out of the colophon, with https://apps.gankdat.com/tax-workbook.html?from=guide as the book's only link — kindle.test.ts checks one mention, one link, no retailer); GUIDE_README_LINE on both workbooks' README tabs under 'Also from the publisher' (title, publisher, 'search the Kindle Store'; no URL), workbook v1.1, release/ rebuilt and recalculated (0 errors), EPUB and paperback (50 pages) rebuilt; tax-workbook.html names the guide and passes ?from=<token> to the Stripe link as client_reference_id; the licence Worker stores it as `ref` (allow-listed token, nothing about the buyer; test); LISTING.md (both descriptions, name only — no link, Etsy's off-site rule) and PAYHIP.md gain the sentence for the owner's next sitting, no new request.
